QuestInfo.name: [Fox Valley] Stormy Disaster
QuestInfo.0: That tree is gigantic now! Way to go, #b#p3002020##k! You should talk to him in #b#m410000118##k to see what the next step of his plan is.
QuestInfo.1:
The storm rages on, and lightning shoots down from the sky, blasting the tree to smithereens... What a crushing blow! But #b#p3002020##k isn't going to give up that easily. He says the villagers will be safe if they take shelter on high ground.

Use the #b#m410000110# left portal#k to get to #m940204105# and help evacuate the villagers.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p3002020##k refused to fail in his duty as leader of the Fox Point Rangers. He said the villagers would be safe from the flooding if they took shelter on high ground, so you rushed over to help evacuate Fox Point Village.

default.0: That's it! We just have to get everyone to higher ground! Let's go!
